description:
Liftoff  is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand. 
 Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence. 
 About the Role: 
 As a Software Engineer at Liftoff working on the Dash team, you will be key in building and scaling the core systems that power our mobile growth platform. You’ll be part of a high-impact engineering team responsible for developing web applications, backing services, APIs and tools that help app developers acquire users, optimize engagement, and drive monetization across millions of devices worldwide. 
 Your contributions will directly impact the performance, reliability, and scalability of our ad delivery, user acquisition, and analytics products. From designing efficient UIs, APIs and services to supporting machine learning pipelines, you'll help ensure our platform remains best-in-class for mobile growth and monetization. 
 Responsibilities: 
 
 Design, build, and maintain UIs, APIs and backend systems that support liftoff accelerate real-time campaign management, bidding, user targeting, and in-app monetization, primarily by developing configuration management and analytics services. 
 Work with large-scale data sources to enable real-time analytics dashboards and reports. 
 Improve our development environment and engineering systems with AI and LLM tooling, championing agentic workflows that raise the whole team’s velocity and quality. 
 Optimize backend systems for high availability and low-latency response under peak global traffic. 
 Contribute to the scalability and observability of the platform through metrics, logging, and alerting best practices. 
 Develop high value user interfaces that optimize user flow, for both internal and external consumers securely, with a high bar for safety and correctness. 
 Partner closely with product managers, UX stakeholders, operations and bidding / ML engineers to deliver cohesive end-to-end features. 
 Participate in architectural design documentation, discussions and long-term technical planning for infrastructure, systems and platform evolution. 
 Continuously evaluate emerging tools and technologies in the mobile ad tech landscape and bring forward recommendations. 
 Actively participate in code reviews and mentorship opportunities to strengthen team-wide engineering excellence. 
 Other duties as assigned. 
 
 Requirements: 
 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered in place of a formal degree. 
 Experience building full stack UI systems. 
 Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Java, Python, or Typescript/Node.js. 
 Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design. 
 Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 Familiarity with leading edge UI technologies, including React. 
 You operate with Agency and Urgency by taking initiative to solve problems and drive outcomes independently, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. 
 You have a Growth Mindset and are adaptable, quick to test, iterate, and improve both ideas and your own skill set. 
 Experience in the mobile advertising or app monetization space is a plus. 
 Exposure to mobile SDKs, ad exchanges, or real-time bidding protocols is a plus. 
 Understanding of data pipelines, stream processing, and large-scale analytics is a plus. 
 Passion for building performant, scalable systems that operate at a global scale.

Who are we and why should you join us? 
 BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us. We’re working to make mental healthcare more accessible, so more people can get the support they need, when they need it. As the world’s largest online therapy service, we’ve connected millions of people with a network of more than 30,000 licensed therapists-- and we’re not stopping there. As the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution. 
 As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. You’ll have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, grow alongside the business, and do meaningful work alongside people who care deeply about what we’re building together. 
 What are we looking for? 
 We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates. 
 You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision. 
 What technologies will you work with? 
 We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software. 
 
 Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis 
 Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS 
 Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery 
 
 We do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our environment. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems. 
 What will you do? 
 
 You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement. 
 You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code. 
 You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners. 
 You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs. 
 You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems. 
 You will write and optimize SQL queries and design relational database schemas. 
 You will create and maintain complex backend services and algorithms. 
 You will profile, troubleshoot, and optimize new and legacy code. 
 You will build experiences that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop environments. 
 You will contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, security, and developer experience. 
 You will ship thoughtfully and frequently in an agile environment with continuous deployment. 
 You will care about our product, mission, and long-term success, well beyond checking off development tasks. 
 You will thoughtfully use approved AI-assisted development tools to reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, and improve productivity while applying your own engineering judgment to architecture, implementation, security, privacy, and code quality. Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision. 
 
 What will you NOT do? 
 
 You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent comp

Software Engineer, Application Integration 
 In Brief 
 
 
 We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. 
 
 
 Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives. 
 
 
 Who We Are 
 Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. 
 We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. 
 Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. 
 
 What you’ll do 
 You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between the Bayesian platform and the clinical workflows inside massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, delivering the real-time lifesaving insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' EHR and clinical informatics teams, you'll bring our clinical insights to the point of care — in the right workflow, at the right moment — empowering care teams to make the best decisions for their patients. 
 Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a clinician says the alert didn't fire for a patient, you have thirty minutes and their full attention to trace it from the EHR launch context through the API to the underlying data, and tell them what happened. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 
 Clinical Workflow Integration:  Extend and configure the full-stack application across the EHR integration surface, coordinating with client EHR and clinical informatics teams, to deliver Bayesian's clinical insights to clinicians. 
 
 
 Integration Testing & Troubleshooting:  Implement automated integration tests and work directly with client technical teams and frontline clinicians during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations. 
 
 
 Production Deployment & Go-Live:  Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring all configurations and builds for the application and workflow are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any application integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication. 
 
 
 Integration Tooling & Automation:  Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale. 
 
 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the application integration workstream with the overall integration effort. 
 
 
 Minimum qualifications 
 
 
 BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience 
 
 
 3+ years build
